text.card: A red giant 2,459 parsecs away, 12 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 3, give 0.79 solar masses and 12.0 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,925 K at its surface.
